summary.headline: Hermes and the False Prophet
summary.text: Hermes recounts exposing a false prophet whose ring and pen performed marvels, distinguishing Aphrodisian and Hermaic arts. Apomasar explains the astrological indications involving Jupiter, the horoskopos, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Virgo, and Libra, followed by a reference to Muhammad son of Moses the Khwarazmian.
